photo.rightsReview: not independently verified; original image remains local and is not included in this receipt

capture.imageHandling: full-frame only; no user-selected or automatic crop in the accepted run

before.reason: The OCR label was fused as Serveasure and the previous parser did not recognize this serving-measure label form.

servingDeclaration.method: A bounded parser extension recognizes serving size/measure forms, including the OCR variant Serveasure, and preserves the source OCR observation. It does not treat a servings-per-pack count as serving mass.

omittedTruncatedNutrientLabel: carbohydrate: OCR label Carbohyd was not associated with its recognized numeric value and printed basis

rawEvidence.limitation: Same-line/image presence does not establish correct row-column association or independent detection precision/recall.

nutritionFields.reference: single human visual read on one exploratory development photo; not independent adjudication or held-out accuracy

productIdentity.reason: The nutrition-panel photo is not an adjudicated identity view.

ingredients.reason: No ingredient-panel reference is present in this nutrition-only photo.

allergens.reason: No allergen reference is annotated for this photo.

downstreamUtility.visibleExample: The initial 38 g portion used the accepted 3.4 g saturated-fat value per 100 g to calculate 1.292 g; the app labels OCR-derived nutrition and calculations as unverified estimates.

browserAndNetwork.note: Paddle model assets were fetched by GET from the configured model host; these are external model downloads, not package-photo uploads.

rejectedAutomaticCropExperiment.method: A bounded crop was derived from OCR geometry and processed with one local contrast pass.
rejectedAutomaticCropExperiment.result: Nutrition remained 5/9; the crop OCR read the printed g unit for total sugars as 9 and the value remained safely unusable.
rejectedAutomaticCropExperiment.decision: Not integrated because it did not improve usable extraction and introduced a new recognition error.

limitations: One Indian-market English oats nutrition photo and one visual reviewer do not establish general accuracy.
The experiment does not measure Indian-language or Devanagari recognition.
Serving recovery is a product utility improvement, not a nutrient-table extraction improvement.
The OCR-to-parser recovery does not establish current product formulation or label truth.
